email.changeConfirm.heading: Confirm your new email address
email.changeConfirm.ignore: If this was not you, ignore this email: nothing changes until the code or the link is used.
email.changeConfirm.intro: Someone asked to use this address for an account on {instance}. Enter this code to confirm the change.
email.changeConfirm.subject: Confirm your new email address
email.changeNotice.heading: Your email address was changed
email.changeNotice.intro: The email address of your account on {instance} was changed to {email}. You were signed out on your other devices.
email.changeNotice.notYou: If you did not make this change, contact the administrator of {instance} straight away.
email.changeNotice.subject: Your email address was changed
email.common.automated: This is an automated message; replies are not read.
email.common.codeExpiry: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.
email.common.linkExpiry: {hours, plural, one {The link is valid for # hour.} other {The link is valid for # hours.}}
email.common.neverShare: Never share this code with anyone. {instance} will never ask you for it.
email.reset.heading: Reset your password
email.reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays the same.
email.reset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your account on {instance}. Enter this code to choose a new password.
email.reset.subject: Reset your password
email.test.heading: Your mail settings work
email.test.intro: This is a test email from {instance}. If you can read it, the server can send email.
email.test.subject: Test email from {instance}
email.verify.heading: Verify your email address
email.verify.ignore: If you did not sign up for {instance}, you can ignore this email.
email.verify.intro: Enter this code in {instance} to confirm that this address belongs to you.
email.verify.subject: Verify your email address
